verses.text: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song; For he hath done marvellous things: His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.

segments.text: Oh sing unto Jehovah a new song;
For he hath done marvellous things:
His right hand, and his holy arm, hath wrought salvation for him.

verses.text: Jehovah hath made known his salvation: His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

segments.text: Jehovah hath made known his salvation:
His righteousness hath he openly showed in the sight of the nations.

verses.text: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel: All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

segments.text: He hath remembered his lovingkindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel:
All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth: Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

segments.text: Make a joyful noise unto Jehovah, all the earth:
Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

verses.text: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

segments.text: Sing praises unto Jehovah with the harp;
With the harp and the voice of melody.

verses.text: With trumpets and sound of cornet Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

segments.text: With trumpets and sound of cornet
Make a joyful noise before the King, Jehovah.

verses.text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;

segments.text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
The world, and they that dwell therein;

verses.text: Let the floods clap their hands; Let the hills sing for joy together

segments.text: Let the floods clap their hands;
Let the hills sing for joy together

verses.text: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth: He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.

segments.text: Before Jehovah; for he cometh to judge the earth:
He will judge the world with righteousness,
And the peoples with equity.
